title: Play ARC Raiders for free: October 8 - 12
body:
# Play ARC Raiders for free: October 8 - 12

Raiders, and those who hope to become Raiders,

The fallen Emperor, and the ARC retaliation that is sure to follow, poses a threat to the very existence of the Rust Belt. Whether your goal is to take the fight directly to ARC or to explore the new frontier in search of riches and new technology, your presence is needed out there.

# Play for free

Between **October 8 (09.00 UTC) and October 12 (08.00 UTC), 2026**, ARC Raiders can be played at **no cost on Steam, Xbox, and Playstation.**

This free access period unlocks the complete ARC Raiders game, giving you the chance to experience the award-winning extraction adventure before committing to a purchase. Use this window to bring your friends in, team up against the ARC, gather whatever supplies you can find, and make your way out safely.

Is now the moment you take your first steps Topside?

# Frozen Trail

This free play window lines up with the release of Frozen Trail, the largest update the game has seen since it launched. Players who are new to the game will be able to reach Pendola Pass right away, as long as they are grouped with other players who already have the new map unlocked.

Gear up and join in for four days of free ARC Raiders access - see you Topside!

The ARC Raiders Team
